versions.changelog: New first row: /lead/check, one call that says whether a sales lead is safe to email (yes, risky or no, with reasons) from the address check, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and domain age.
Leads with the sales-lead check: verify the address, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, domain age. Fixes two rows that named the wrong HTTP method - /email-auth is POST and /web/extract is GET.
First ClawHub release: pay-per-call DNS, SSL, WHOIS, IP, email and web lookups over x402, paid from the agent's own wallet.
